summary: @Todd_Conaway On a mission to squelch the use of the word "easy" as well...and I cringe as I use it when describing how to use flexbox (like literally just now in a recording) to add images to student portfolios....Efficient....I like that change....

body_html: @Todd_Conaway On a mission to squelch the use of the word "easy" as well...and I cringe as I use it when describing how to use flexbox (like literally just now in a recording) to add images to student portfolios....Efficient....I like that change....
